[PREFERENCE] User is looking for advice on vacuuming schedules.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Vacuuming frequency depends on several factors, including the size of the home, number of occupants, pets, and personal preference for cleanliness.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] General guidelines for vacuuming frequency:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] High-traffic areas: Daily or every other day.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Low-traffic areas: Weekly.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Deep cleaning: Bi-weekly or monthly.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional considerations include vacuuming more frequently if the user has pets, allergies, or a large family.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Monthly or seasonal tasks include deep cleaning high-traffic areas, rotating area rugs, and inspecting vacuum filters.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User can schedule daily or weekly reminders for quick vacuuming sessions and set aside a specific day for deeper cleaning or special tasks.
